about.metaDescription: The people, kitchen principles and process behind Olive & Ember catering studio (demo content).
about.title: A studio kitchen built around the guest list
about.intro: Olive & Ember is a placeholder catering studio created for this portfolio. Replace this story with your own founding story, team and values.
story: We started with a simple frustration: big events where the food was either familiar and careless, or impressive and cold. Our kitchen is built to do both — dum-cooked classics that taste like home, served with the precision of a restaurant pass.
Today the studio plans weddings, workplace catering and private dinners from one central kitchen. Every event gets a single captain who knows the menu, the venue and the timeline.

values.title: Seasonal & local first
values.text: Menus follow the market — hilsa in monsoon, nolen gur in winter.

values.title: Honest quantities
values.text: Portions planned per guest list, not padded to inflate the bill.

values.title: Kitchen discipline
values.text: Temperature-controlled transport and documented hygiene routines (describe your real practices here).

privacy.metaDescription: How enquiry and quote information is collected and used (template).
privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: This website is operated by the business named in the site settings (currently a placeholder). Contact details are listed on the Contact page.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: When you submit the quote or contact form we collect the details you enter: name, phone, email, event date, venue, guest count, dietary needs and notes. We do not collect payment information on this website.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: Only to respond to your enquiry, prepare a proposal and deliver the event you book. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: Storage & retention
sections.body: In this demo, form submissions are validated and discarded — nothing is stored. When a real integration is configured, describe where data is stored and for how long.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The site may set a locale cookie to remember your language. No analytics or advertising cookies are configured in this demo.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete the information you have shared by contacting us.

terms.metaDescription: Booking, payment, cancellation and service terms for catering (template).
terms.title: Terms & conditions

sections.title: Quotes & estimates
sections.body: Prices shown on this website, including estimator results, are indicative demo values. Only a signed written proposal sets the final price.

sections.title: Booking & advance payment
sections.body: A date is confirmed once the proposal is signed and the advance stated in it is received.

sections.title: Guest numbers
sections.body: Final guest numbers must be confirmed by the deadline in your proposal. Charges are based on the confirmed number or actual attendance, whichever is higher.

sections.title: Cancellation & changes
sections.body: Cancellation charges and refund terms are set out in your proposal. Placeholder: replace with your actual policy.

sections.title: Allergies & dietary needs
sections.body: We label dishes and plan for declared needs, but our kitchen handles common allergens, so zero cross-contact cannot be guaranteed.

sections.title: Venue responsibilities
sections.body: The client is responsible for venue access, permissions and any venue-imposed fees unless agreed otherwise in writing.
